## Pull request overview Moves detailed privilege-mode access control documentation for HPM counters from unprivileged `hpmcounter*` CSRs into the corresponding M-mode `mhpmcounter*` CSRs, so access-control behavior is documented alongside the controlling M-mode CSRs (`mcounteren`, etc.). Unprivileged CSRs are updated to reference the M-mode entries for those details. **Changes:** - Add access-control descriptions/tables to `mhpmcounterN` / `mhpmcounterNh` (layout + concrete YAMLs). - Replace verbose access-control tables in `hpmcounter*` with cross-references to `mhpmcounter*`. - Update pre-commit configuration to exclude HPM counter YAMLs from `end-of-file-fixer` (but currently misconfigured—see comment). ### Reviewed changes Copilot reviewed 121 out of 121 changed files in this pull request and generated 1 comment.
